# Awesome Blender — Full Catalog

> Complete plain-Markdown index of 600 curated Blender add-ons, AI & MCP workflows, 3D assets, standalone tools, tutorials, and community links (567 free, 33 paid, 202 GitHub repos, 40 Blender Extensions). Index: https://awesome-blender.vercel.app/llms.txt
## Add-ons

- [Browse official and community-reviewed extensions on the Blender Extensions Platform (Blender 4.2+), or check the built-in add-ons documentation.](https://extensions.blender.org/)

### Simulation/Physics

- [FLIP Fluids](https://github.com/rlguy/Blender-FLIP-Fluids): Powerful liquid simulation plugin that gives you the ability to create high quality fluid effects all within Blender, the free and open source 3D creation suite. `[open-source]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/flipfluids))
- [MolecularNodes](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/molecularnodes/): Import, animate, and simulate molecular biology and structural data inside Blender using Geometry Nodes. `[GPL · ext:molecularnodes]` ([Repository](https://github.com/BradyAJohnston/MolecularNodes))
- [Molecular+](https://github.com/u3dreal/molecular-plus): Modernized continuation of the [Molecular Script](https://github.com/scorpion81/Blender-Molecular-Script) add-on for particle collisions, linking, and physics simulations in Blender 4.x. `[GPL]` ([Molecular Script](https://github.com/scorpion81/Blender-Molecular-Script))
- [projectile](https://github.com/develeon/projectile): An artist-friendly tool for throwing stuff around inside blender. `[open-source]`
- [Phobos](https://github.com/dfki-ric/phobos): An add-on for Blender allowing to create URDF, SDF and SMURF robot models. `[open-source]`
- [Blender Optics Simulator](https://github.com/emircbngl/blender-optics-simulator): An add-on that turns Blender into a physics-checked optical bench: live beam tracing with polarization and Gaussian-beam propagation, real opto-mechanical mounts, and a headless Python API. `[GPL]`
- [Stop-motion-OBJ](https://github.com/neverhood311/Stop-motion-OBJ): Import sequences of `.obj`, `.ply`, or `.stl` mesh files (such as external fluid or particle simulations) as animated mesh sequences in Blender. `[GPL]`

### Generator/Builder

#### Characters & Faces

- [CharMorph](https://blenderartists.org/t/charmorph-character-creation-tool-mb-lab-based/1252543): Open-source character creation tool for Blender, built as a modern rewrite of MB-Lab. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Upliner/CharMorph))
- [MPFB](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mpfb/): Open-source human generator for Blender and complete rewrite of MakeHuman as a native add-on. [[docs]](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb.html) `[ext:mpfb]` ([Repository](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2))
- [FaceBuilder](https://keentools.io/download/facebuilder-for-blender): Creates photorealistic 3D models of human faces and heads from a few reference photographs. [[medium]](https://medium.com/keentools/facebuilder-for-blender-guide-cbb10c717f7c) `[paid]`

#### Environment, Terrain & Vegetation

- [Infinigen](https://infinigen.org): Procedural generator of photorealistic 3D worlds, nature, and indoor scenes using real geometry, optimized for computer vision and 3D training data. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen))
- [The Grove 3D](https://www.thegrove3d.com/): Simulates natural tree growth, branching, pruning, and seasonal changes for visualization and film. `[paid]`
- [Modular Tree](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/modular-tree/): Node-based procedural tree and vegetation generator for Blender. `[ext:modular-tree]` ([Repository](https://github.com/GoodPie/modular_tree))
- [Sapling Tree Gen](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/sapling-tree-gen/): Parametric Weber-Penn trees with leaves, pruning, armature rigs, and wind animation. `[GPL · ext:sapling-tree-gen]`
- [tree-gen](https://github.com/friggog/tree-gen): Procedural tree model generator in Blender. `[open-source]`

#### Architecture, Props & Data

- [Buildify](https://paveloliva.gumroad.com/l/buildify): Geometry Nodes library for modular procedural building creation.
- [SceneCity](https://superhivemarket.com/products/scenecity): Generates large-scale road networks and places tens of thousands of procedural and custom buildings. `[paid]`
- [BookGen](https://www.oweissbarth.de/software/book-gen-blender-addon/): Free book-generation add-on for shelves and interior scenes in Blender.
- [Bricker](https://superhivemarket.com/products/bricker): Converts 3D meshes and simulations into photorealistic Lego and Minecraft brick models. `[paid]`
- [Sprytile](https://github.com/Sprytile/Sprytile): Builds tile-based low-poly scenes in Blender with paint and map-editor tools. [[more info]](https://jeiel.itch.io/sprytile) `[open-source]`
- [Mesh Maze](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mesh-maze/): Generates procedural maze patterns over any mesh surface. `[ext:mesh-maze]` ([Repository](https://github.com/elfnor/mesh_maze))
- [Blender Data Visualisation](https://github.com/Griperis/BlenderDataVis): Loads data into Blender and generates 3D charts and visualizations. `[open-source]`

#### Scatter

- [Geo-Scatter](https://superhivemarket.com/products/scatter): Professional biome and instancing scattering system for Blender. `[paid]`
- [BagaPie Modifier](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/bagapie/): Modifier and Geometry Nodes preset toolkit including booleans, scattering, arrays, and architecture tools. `[GPL · ext:bagapie]`
- [City Scatter](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/city_scatter_free): Generates cityscape concepts powered by Blender's collection system.

#### Geometry Nodes Packs & Presets

- [Geometry Nodes Demo](https://www.blender.org/download/demo-files/#geometry-nodes): Official Blender Geometry Nodes example files, including procedural buildings and hex grids.
- [Higgsas Geometry Nodes](https://higgsas.gumroad.com/l/wrusot): Extensive collection of utility and deformer node groups for Geometry Nodes, plus [Mesh Tension Map](https://higgsas.gumroad.com/l/tnqal). ([Mesh Tension Map](https://higgsas.gumroad.com/l/tnqal))
- [b3dsdf](https://github.com/williamchange/b3dsdf): Over 170 signed distance functions (SDF), vector operations, and procedural utility node groups for Shader Editor and Geometry Nodes in Blender. `[GPL]`
- [Curtis Holt's Generators](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com): Free Geometry Nodes generators including [Space Station](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/space_station_gen_free), [Mech](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/mech_gen_free), and [Weapon](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/random_weapon_generator). ([Space Station](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/space_station_gen_free), [Mech](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/mech_gen_free), [Weapon](https://curtisjamesholt.gumroad.com/l/random_weapon_generator))

### Modeling

#### All-in-One Toolkits & Interactive Creation

- [MACHIN3tools](https://gumroad.com/l/MACHIN3tools): Continuously evolving collection of blender tools and pie menus in a single customizable package. `[paid]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/MACHIN3tools))
- [KeKit](https://ke-code.xyz/scripts/kekit): Brings some much needed functionality to Blender, with a whole array of production tools.
- [Maxivz’s Interactive Tools](https://gumroad.com/l/ynJmIV): Collection of intuitive, context sensitive tools for Blender.
- [PolyQuilt](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/polyquilt-fork/): Provides a few functions in edit mode like creating faces, knife tool, fan, edge-loops, etc. It does this with only the left-mouse-button. So no menu’s, no shortcuts. [[more info]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VKLPHh3CYCU) `[ext:polyquilt-fork]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Dangry98/PolyQuilt-for-Blender-4.0))
- [QBlocker](https://qblockerdocs.readthedocs.io/): Interactive object creation tool for Blender.
- [fspy](https://fspy.io/): Open-source camera matching app, extremely useful for modeling directly from a reference image. [(blender addon)](https://github.com/perarnia/fSpy-Blender) `[open-source]` ([(blender addon)](https://github.com/perarnia/fSpy-Blender))

#### Edit Mode, Curves & Modifiers

- [Auto Mirror](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/auto-mirror/): Automate a series of tasks, such as deleting a half, setting a mirror modifier, setting a clipping, etc. [[thread]](https://blenderartists.org/t/auto-mirror-ex/1151539) `[ext:auto-mirror]`
- [Drop It](https://blenderartists.org/t/drop-it-free-addon/1244259/): Designed to drop fast and simply Objects to Ground or Surface. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/maxivz/interactivetoolsblender))
- [BezierUtility](https://github.com/Shriinivas/blenderbezierutils): This add-on contains several tools for working with Bezier curves. `[open-source]`
- [Modeling Cloth](https://github.com/the3dadvantage/Modeling-Cloth): Create real-time cloth-like behavior in meshes in Blender. `[open-source]`
- [JewelCraft](https://github.com/mrachinskiy/jewelcraft): Jewelry design toolkit add-on for Blender. `[open-source]`

#### CAD

- [Bonsai (formerly BlenderBIM)](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/bonsai/): An add-on for beautiful, detailed, and data-rich OpenBIM with Blender. [[website]](https://bonsaibim.org) `[GPL · ext:bonsai]` ([Repository](https://github.com/IfcOpenShell/IfcOpenShell))
- [Archipack](https://gumroad.com/l/ZRMyP): The Archipack addon for Blender contains a collection of parametric primitives for ArchViz. You can manipulate these primitives with a realtime on-screen editing interface. `[paid]`
- [Building Tools](https://github.com/ranjian0/building_tools): Building generation addon for blender. `[open-source]`
- [Sverchok](https://nortikin.github.io/sverchok/): Powerful parametric tool for architects, allowing geometry to be programmed visually with nodes. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nortikin/sverchok))
- [CAD Sketcher](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/cad-sketcher/): CAD Sketcher is a free and open-source project looking to enhance precision workflows in blender by bringing CAD like tools, features and usability. [[website]](https://www.cadsketcher.com) `[GPL · ext:cad-sketcher]` ([Repository](https://github.com/hlorus/CAD_Sketcher))
- [CAD Transform](https://blenderartists.org/t/cad-like-transform/1226197): CAD Transform provide intuitive snap from/to workflow, allow precise move/rotate/scale using advanced snap options and constraints in both object and edit mode. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/s-leger/blender_cad_transforms))
- [MeasureIt-ARCH](https://github.com/kevancress/MeasureIt_ARCH): An expansion of Antonio Vazquez's MeasureIt addon to add features to create Architectural Drawings. `[open-source]`
- [JARCH-Vis](https://blenderartists.org/t/addon-jarch-vis/642607): Add-on for Blender 3D that helps create commonly used object for architectural visualization. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/BlendingJake/JARCH-Vis))
- [Fusion to Blender Bridge](https://github.com/inspace9018/fusion-to-blender-bridge): One-click sync from Fusion 360 to Blender. Geometry updates on each CAD revision while materials, modifiers and hand-marked edges stay. `[GPL]`

#### 3D Printing & Manufacturing/CAM

- [3D Print Toolbox](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/print3d-toolbox/): Must-have utilities to clean and prepare models for 3D printing in Blender. `[GPL · ext:print3d-toolbox]`
- [Snapsplit](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/snapsplit/): Automates cut and connection building workflows for complex 3D models larger than your printing bed, generating precise glue-free snap-fit connectors. `[ext:snapsplit]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Betakontext/snapsplit))
- [Click Joints](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/click-joints/): Cuts printable ball-and-socket or pin joints into a mesh with clearance in mm and shows how far each ball joint bends before the parts collide. `[GPL · ext:click-joints]` ([Repository](https://github.com/thijsduinhouwer2002-coder/click-joints))
- [BlenderCAM](https://blendercam.com): An Open Source solution for CAM with Blender 3D. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/vilemduha/blendercam))

#### Retopology/Remesh

- [RetopoFlow](https://github.com/CGCookie/retopoflow): A suite of retopology tools for Blender. `[open-source]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/retopoflow))
- [QRemeshify](https://github.com/ksami/QRemeshify): Blender extension for an easy-to-use remesher that outputs high-quality quad topology. `[GPL]`
- [SpeedRetopo](https://gumroad.com/l/speedretopo): Free add-on for Blender to make fast and easy retopology using Bsurface.

#### Hard Surface

- [KIT OPS](https://gumroad.com/l/kitops): Can create objects and scenes with extreme efficiency and speed. Complex industrial designs can be generated in a single sitting.
- [ND](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/nd/): Free non-destructive & interactive hard surface toolkit (smart modifiers, booleans, and geometry management). `[ext:nd]` ([Repository](https://github.com/hugemenace/nd), [Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/nd-addon))
- [HardOps/Boxcutter](https://superhivemarket.com/products/hard-ops--boxcutter-ultimate-bundle): [HardOps](https://superhivemarket.com/products/hardopsofficial), is intended to be a workflow assistant toolkit. [Boxcutter](https://superhivemarket.com/products/boxcutter), the most powerful boolean subsystem for blender. `[paid]` ([HardOps](https://superhivemarket.com/products/hardopsofficial), [Boxcutter](https://superhivemarket.com/products/boxcutter))
- [Speedflow](https://gumroad.com/l/speedflow): Addon for non-destructive workflow. `[paid]`
- [EdgeFlow](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/edgeflow/): This addon adds two operators to blender which both work on edgeloop selections. `[ext:edgeflow]` ([Repository](https://github.com/BenjaminSauder/EdgeFlow))

#### Sculpt

- [Speedsculpt](https://gumroad.com/l/SpeedSculpt): The addon allows you to create very fast characters, to manage Dyntopo Sculpting with booleans, cut curves, skin modifier, decimate, mask etc. `[paid]`
- [GoB](https://github.com/JoseConseco/GoB): GoZ-alike tools for simple ZBrush-Blender interchange. `[open-source]`

#### Snapping-Align

- [Mesh Align Plus](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mesh-mesh-align-plus/): Precisely align, move, and measure+match objects and mesh parts in your 3D scenes. `[ext:mesh-mesh-align-plus]` ([Repository](https://github.com/egtwobits/mesh_mesh_align_plus))
- [Blign](https://jack-cooke.github.io/blign/): Alignment and distribution tool for Blender. It allows users to align and distribute shapes with many different options.

#### Mesh Generate/Stylization

- [Tissue](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/tissue/): Add-on for computational design. `[ext:tissue]` ([Repository](https://github.com/alessandro-zomparelli/tissue))
- [BY-GEN](https://gumroad.com/l/BY-GEN): Addon designed to simplify the process of creating non-destructive, generative modeling styles in Blender. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/curtisjamesholt/BY-GEN-public))

### Animation

- [Commotion](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/commotion/): Blender add-on for motion graphics. `[ext:commotion]` ([Repository](https://github.com/mrachinskiy/commotion))
- [Animax](https://superhivemarket.com/products/animax---procedural-animation-system-): Procedural animation system for Blender. Useful for animating multiple objects. `[paid]`
- [COA Tools](https://github.com/ndee85/coa_tools): 2D Animation Suite for blender. It offers a 2D cutout animation workflow similar to programs like spine or spriter. `[open-source]`
- [reflow](https://gitlab.com/diegogangl/reflow): Blender addon to change fps. `[open-source]`
- [Stop-Mo](https://superhivemarket.com/products/stop-mo): Transforms animations into a beautiful, hand-crafted stop motion style.
- [Blender NLA Midi Copier](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/nla-midi-copier/): Blender add-on for creating midi-driven animations from the Nonlinear Animation view. `[ext:nla-midi-copier]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Cornerback24/Blender-NLA-Midi-Copier))
- [BlendyPose](https://github.com/zonkypop/BlendyPose): Blender Motion Capture using your camera. `[open-source]`

#### Rigging

- [CloudRig](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/cloudrig/): Blender Studio's official feature-film quality Rigify feature set and rig generator for Blender. `[GPL · ext:cloudrig]` ([Repository](https://projects.blender.org/extensions/cloudrig))
- [BlenRig](https://github.com/jpbouza/BlenRig): BlenRig is an Auto-rigging and skinning system. It provides the user with a Feature Film quality rig; including an advanced facial system. `[GPL]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/blenrig))
- [Rig on the Fly](https://gitlab.com/dypsloom/rigonthefly): Rig on the Fly is a Blender dynamic rigging tool used to simplify and speed up animation workflow. `[open-source]`
- [Auto-Rig Pro](https://superhivemarket.com/products/auto-rig-pro): Auto-Rig Pro is an addon for Blender to rig characters, retarget animations, and provide Fbx export, with presets for Unity and Unreal Engine. `[paid]`
- [Rigacar](https://digicreatures.net/articles/rigacar.html): Generate a complete rig as quickly as possible for standard car models. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/digicreatures/rigacar))
- [Wiggle Bones](https://blenderartists.org/t/wiggle-2/1454788): Jiggle bone implementation for Blender with realistic physics. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/shteeve3d/blender-wiggle-2))
- [Spring Bones](https://github.com/artellblender/springbones): Blender addon to add spring/bouncy dynamic effect to bones. `[open-source]`
- [Bone Widget](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/bone-widget/): Blender addon to assist with making custom bone shapes. `[ext:bone-widget]` ([Repository](https://github.com/waylow/boneWidget))

### Render Engine

- [DreamWork's MoonRay](https://openmoonray.org/): MoonRay is a physically based path-tracing renderer; it includes a USD Hydra render delegate, multi-machine and cloud rendering via the Arras distributed computation framework. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/OpenMoonRay/openmoonray))
- [Pixar's RenderMan](https://renderman.pixar.com/): Physically-based render from Pixar. [[more info]](https://rmanwiki.pixar.com/display/RFB24) `[MIT]`
- [OctaneRender Prime for Blender](https://home.otoy.com/render/octane-render/demo/#prime): Fully integrated Octane Render, free tier. [(blender plugin manual)](https://docs.otoy.com/BlenderH/BlenderPluginManual.htm) ([(blender plugin manual)](https://docs.otoy.com/BlenderH/BlenderPluginManual.htm))
- [Redshift Blender Integration](https://www.maxon.net/en/redshift): Redshift by Maxon is a GPU-accelerated renderer built to meet the specific demands of contemporary high-end production rendering. `[paid]`
- [LuxCore](https://luxcorerender.org/): LuxCoreRender is a physically based and unbiased rendering engine. It offers advanced features like accelerated rendering of indirect light and efficient rendering of caustics. [(blender addon)](https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore) `[GPL]` ([(blender addon)](https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore), [Repository](https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/LuxCore))
- [Malt](https://malt3d.com/): Malt is a non photorealistic rendering (NPR) framework. It offers fully customizable real-time rendering framework for animation and illustration. `[MIT]` ([Repository](https://github.com/bnpr/Malt))
- [Mitsuba Renderer](https://www.mitsuba-renderer.org/): Mitsuba 3 is a research-oriented retargetable rendering system for forward and inverse light transport simulation. [(blender addon)](https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/mitsuba-blender) `[open-source]` ([(blender addon)](https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/mitsuba-blender), [Repository](https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/mitsuba3))
- [K-Cycles](https://superhivemarket.com/products/k-cycles): Optimized custom Cycles build featuring faster GPU rendering, post-processing effects, and performance presets. `[paid]`

### Texture/UV

#### UV Unwrapping, Packing & Texel Density

- [TexTools](https://blenderartists.org/t/textools-for-blender/700811): TexTools is a Free addon for Blender 3D with a set of professional UV and Texturing tools. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/franMarz/TexTools-Blender))
- [Magic UV](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/magic-uv/): This is a blender add-on Magic UV consisted of many UV manipulation features which Blender lack of. [[docs]](https://nutti.github.io/Magic-UV/) `[ext:magic-uv]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nutti/Magic-UV))
- [DreamUV](https://github.com/leukbaars/DreamUV): Collection of tools that allow you to manipulate UVs in the 3D viewport. `[open-source]`
- [UV-Packer](https://www.uv-packer.com/blender/): Automatic and free UV-Packer Add-on for Blender.
- [UVgami](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/uvgami/): Automatic UV unwrapping add-on for Blender with minimal distortion. `[GPL · ext:uvgami]` ([Repository](https://github.com/danielboxer/UVgami))
- [UV Toolkit](https://gumroad.com/alexbel#NbMya): Tools collection for UV editing in blender.
- [Texel Density Checker](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/texel-density-checker/): Tools for calculate, set and copy texel density. `[ext:texel-density-checker]` ([Repository](https://github.com/mrven/Blender-Texel-Density-Checker))

#### Texture Baking

- [Bake Wrangler](https://blenderartists.org/t/bake-wrangler-node-based-baking-tool-set/1187732): Nodes based extension and replacement for the inbuilt baking system.
- [Bystedts Blender Baker](https://3dbystedt.gumroad.com/l/JAqLT): This addon streamlines the texture baking process in Blender.

#### Material Libraries, Layer Painting & Bridges

- [UcuPaint](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/ucupaint/): A addon to manage texture layers for EEVEE and Cycles renderer. `[ext:ucupaint]` ([Repository](https://github.com/ucupumar/ucupaint))
- [Grungit](https://abdoubouam.gumroad.com/l/grungit): Grungit is an addon that automatically and effortlessly adds wear and tear to your models with a single click. The result is fully controllable and can deliver anything from imperfections and light wear to heavy damage. `[GPL]`
- [Sanctus Library](https://superhivemarket.com/products/sanctus-library-addon---procedural-shaders-collection-for-blender/): The ever-growing procedural material library for Blender. `[paid]`
- [Poliigon Blender Addon](https://help.poliigon.com/en/articles/6342599-poliigon-blender-addon): Allows you to browse, purchase, download, and import Poliigon assets from inside Blender. It supports loading textures, models, and HDRs, and more recently supports generating blender files for use in the Blender Asset Browser.
- [Lily Surface Scrapper](https://github.com/eliemichel/LilySurfaceScraper): Import shaders in Blender from a single URL. `[open-source]`

### GameDev

- [MeshSync](https://github.com/unity3d-jp/MeshSync): Live link plugin for Unity. supported blender and other 3D software. `[open-source]`
- [Mr Mannequins Tools](https://github.com/Jim-Kroovy/mr_mannequins_tools): Blender add-on that gives the ability to export animations and weighted meshes that are directly compatible with the third person mannequin without re-targeting anything in Unreal Engine! `[open-source]`
- [Blender For Unreal Engine](https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons): This Add-on allows you to export content created with Blender to Unreal Engine. `[open-source]`
- [V-HACD](https://blenderartists.org/t/v-hacd-tool-for-creating-accurate-convex-collision-meshes-for-real-time-physics-in-games-etc/1156822): Library decomposes a 3D surface into a set of near convex parts. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/andyp123/blender_vhacd))
- [Blenvy](https://github.com/kaosat-dev/Blenvy): Blender-centric workflow and component editor for the Rust-based Bevy game engine. `[MIT]`
- [Asset Creation Toolset](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/act-game-asset-creation-toolset/): Asset Creation Toolset is many tools for game asset creation. `[ext:act-game-asset-creation-toolset]` ([Repository](https://github.com/mrven/Blender-Asset-Creation-Toolset))
- [SourceIO](https://github.com/REDxEYE/SourceIO): Blender 4.0+ add-on for importing Valve Source and Source 2 engine textures, models, and maps. `[MIT]`
- [CC/iClone Blender Tools](https://github.com/soupday/cc_blender_tools): Add-on for importing and auto-setting up Reallusion Character Creator 3/4 and iClone 7/8 characters in Blender. `[GPL]`
- [Anvil Level Design](https://github.com/alexjhetherington/anvil-level-design): TrenchBroom-inspired level design toolset for Blender with automated material assignment and UV management. `[GPL]`

#### Game Engine

- [Armory3D](https://armory3d.org/): Open-source 3D game engine with full Blender integration. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/armory3d/armory))
- [UPBGE](https://upbge.org/): Open-source 3D game engine forked from old Blender Game Engine, deployed with Blender itself. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/UPBGE/upbge))

### Lighting, Camera & Video

#### Lighting & Environment

- [Gaffer](https://github.com/gregzaal/Gaffer): Light manager that presents all scene lighting and HDRI settings in streamlined panels for quick experimentation. `[open-source]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/gaffer-light-manager/))
- [Extra Lights](https://github.com/jlampel/extra_lights): Adds physically based, photometric lighting presets to the Add menu. `[open-source]` ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/extra-lights))
- [HDRI Sun Aligner](https://github.com/akej74/hdri-sun-aligner): Automatically rotates a sun lamp or object to match the brightest point in an HDRI environment texture. `[open-source]`
- [LeoMoon LightStudio](https://leomoon.com/store/plugins/leomoon-lightstudio/): Interactive studio lighting system for Blender. ([Superhive](https://superhivemarket.com/products/leomoon-lightstudio))
- [Physical Starlight and Atmosphere](https://superhivemarket.com/products/physical-starlight-and-atmosphere): Full procedural sky, sunlight, and atmosphere simulator for visual consistency across scenes. `[paid]`
- [Projectors](https://github.com/Ocupe/Projectors): Physically plausible projector creation and modification in Cycles and EEVEE. `[open-source]`

#### Camera

- [Photographer 2](https://gumroad.com/chafouin#FWQf): Physical camera exposure, white balance, and autofocus controls (v2 available for free).
- [Camera Shakify](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/camera-shakify/): Adds realistic, motion-captured camera shake to Blender cameras. `[ext:camera-shakify]` ([Repository](https://github.com/EatTheFuture/camera_shakify))

#### Render & Batch Utilities

- [Loom](https://github.com/p2or/blender-loom): Simplifies rendering of specific frame ranges, batch rendering, and background encoding. `[open-source]`

#### Video Sequence Editor (VSE) & Audio

- [Power Sequencer](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/power-sequencer/): Free and open-source productivity tools for faster editing in Blender's Video Sequence Editor. `[ext:power-sequencer]` ([Repository](https://github.com/GDQuest/blender-power-sequencer))
- [VSEQF](https://github.com/snuq/VSEQF): Quick Functions overhaul for Blender VSE focused on real-time feedback and mouse/keyboard editing. `[open-source]`
- [Push to Talk](https://github.com/britalmeida/push_to_talk): Record scratch dialogue directly into the VSE timeline. `[open-source]`
- [LUT Exporter](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/blender-lut-exporter/): Exports `.cube` LUT files from VSE adjustment layers. `[ext:blender-lut-exporter]` ([Repository](https://github.com/ichlubna/BlenderLUTExporter))

### Pipeline, I/O & 3D Scanning

#### Import & Software Bridges

- [VRM Add-on for Blender](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/vrm/): Adds VRM humanoid avatar import, export, shading, and rigging capabilities to Blender. `[MIT · ext:vrm]` ([Repository](https://github.com/saturday06/VRM-Addon-for-Blender))
- [Sketchfab Blender Addon](https://github.com/sketchfab/blender-plugin): Browse, import, and upload 3D models directly between Sketchfab and Blender. `[open-source]`
- [Substance 3D add-on for Blender by Adobe](https://substance3d.adobe.com/magazine/the-substance-3d-add-on-for-blender-is-here/): Load and tweak parametric Substance `.sbsar` materials directly inside Blender.
- [Daz to Blender Bridge](https://www.daz3d.com/daz-to-blender-bridge): Transfers Genesis characters and rigs from Daz Studio directly into Blender.
- [LibSM64-Blender](https://github.com/libsm64/libsm64-blender): Integrates `libsm64` physics and Mario 64 character workflows into Blender. `[open-source]`
- **Format Importers**: [Daz Importer](https://bitbucket.org/Diffeomorphic/import_daz), [Rhinoceros 3D (.3dm)](https://blenderartists.org/t/import-rhinoceros-3d-files-into-blender/1136070), [XPS/XNALara](https://github.com/johnzero7/XNALaraMesh)

#### Export & Format Converters

- [Export Paper Model from Blender](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/export-paper-model/): Unfolds 3D meshes into printable SVG/PDF papercraft patterns. [[docs]](https://addam.github.io/Export-Paper-Model-from-Blender/) `[ext:export-paper-model]` ([Repository](https://github.com/addam/Export-Paper-Model-from-Blender))
- [Batex](https://github.com/jayanam/batex): Batch-exports selected objects as FBX compatible with Unity's coordinate and scaling system. `[open-source]`
- [Export Object Dimensions](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/export-object-dimensions/): Exports width, height, depth, and volume of selected objects to TXT, CSV, or JSON with unit conversion. `[GPL · ext:export-object-dimensions]` ([Repository](https://github.com/rafaeloliveiraz/blender-dimexport))
- **Format Exporters**: [Bezier2SVG](https://leomoon.com/store/plugins/leomoon-bezier2svg/), [Panda3D (blend2bam)](https://github.com/Moguri/blend2bam), [X-Ray Engine](https://github.com/PavelBlend/blender-xray)

#### Photogrammetry & Gaussian Splatting

- [3DGS Render by KIRI Engine](https://github.com/Kiri-Innovation/3dgs-render-blender-addon): Open-source add-on for importing, editing, deforming, and rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting (`.ply`) scenes directly inside Blender. `[GPL]`
- [Gauss Cannon](https://github.com/warpgatelabs/gauss-cannon): Utilities for generating and managing 3D Gaussian Splats directly from Blender scenes. `[GPL]`
- [Gaussian Splat to Nodes](https://github.com/gokayfem/gaussian-splat-to-blender-nodes): Toolkit for reconstructing 3D Gaussian Splats as editable Geometry Nodes meshes and shader setups in Blender. `[MIT]`
- [Gaussian Splatting Blender Add-on](https://github.com/ReshotAI/gaussian-splatting-blender-addon): Lightweight utility to import and visualize 3D Gaussian Splats inside the Blender viewport. `[MIT]`
- [Photogrammetry Importer](https://github.com/SBCV/Blender-Addon-Photogrammetry-Importer): Imports reconstruction outputs from COLMAP, Meshroom, OpenMVG, and VisualSFM into Blender. `[open-source]`
- [blenderkitti](https://github.com/risteon/blender_kitti): Renders large LiDAR point clouds and voxel grids in Blender. `[open-source]`

#### Geographic & Maps

- [BlenderGIS](https://github.com/domlysz/BlenderGIS): Bridges Blender with geographic data (shapefiles, DEM elevation, satellite imagery, and OpenStreetMap). `[open-source]`
- [Maps Models Importer](https://github.com/eliemichel/MapsModelsImporter): Imports 3D city captures from Google Maps into Blender. [[more info]](https://blog.exppad.com/article/importing-actual-3d-models-from-google-maps) `[open-source]`
- [blender-osm](https://gumroad.com/l/blender-osm): One-click download and import of OpenStreetMap buildings and terrain for Blender.

#### Web, XR & Collaboration

- [Needle Engine](https://engine.needle.tools/docs/blender/): Creates interactive, lightweight Three.js / WebXR web applications directly inside Blender.
- [Verge3D](https://www.soft8soft.com/get-verge3d/): Toolkit for creating interactive 3D web experiences and product configurators from Blender scenes.
- [Multi-user](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/multi-user/): Enables real-time multi-user collaborative scene editing inside Blender. [[thread]](https://blenderartists.org/t/multi-user/1187118) `[ext:multi-user]` ([Repository](https://gitlab.com/slumber/multi-user))

### Workflow, UI & Utilities

#### Asset & Scene Management

- [BlenderKit](https://www.blendkit.com/): Download 3D models, PBR materials, HDRIs, and brushes directly into Blender.
- [FontSelector](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/font-selector/): Visual font browsing and management inside Blender. `[ext:font-selector]` ([Repository](https://github.com/samytichadou/FontSelector_blender_addon/))
- [Simple Renaming Panel](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/simple-renaming-panel/): Batch-rename objects, bones, materials, and data-blocks with prefix/suffix and regex rules. `[ext:simple-renaming-panel]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Weisl/simple_renaming))
- [Lodify](https://forum.blender.org/t/level-of-detail-addon/12840): Level of Detail (LOD) and proxy mesh management system for Blender. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/DB3D/Lodify))
- [PowerSave](https://gumroad.com/l/powersave): Streamlined incremental saving and autosave management for Blender artists.

#### Viewport & UI Enhancements

- [Modifier List](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/modifier-list-fork/): Enhanced compact UI layout, sidebar tab, and popup menu for managing modifier stacks. [[thread]](https://blenderartists.org/t/modifier-list-for-blender-4-2-addon-fork/1512291) `[ext:modifier-list-fork]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Symstract/modifier_list))
- [QuickSwitch](https://github.com/schroef/QuickSwitch): Pie menu helper to quickly switch workspaces and render views. `[open-source]`
- [Screencast-Keys](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/screencast-keys/): Displays keyboard and mouse inputs on-screen for tutorials and demos. `[ext:screencast-keys]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nutti/Screencast-Keys))
- [Leviate for Blender](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/leviate/): Navigate the 3D viewport or move objects using webcam/phone hand tracking inside Blender. `[ext:leviate]` ([Repository](https://github.com/vladpereverzyev/leviate))

#### Nodes

- [Node Pie](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/nodepie/): Fast pie menu for searching and adding new nodes in the Shader and Geometry Node editors. `[ext:nodepie]` ([Repository](https://github.com/strike-digital/node_pie))
- [NodeToPython](https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/node-to-python/): Converts Geometry, Shader, and Compositing node trees into clean, reusable Python scripts and add-ons. `[MIT · ext:node-to-python]` ([Repository](https://github.com/BrendanParmer/NodeToPython))

## AI & MCP

### MCP, Agents & Skills

- [BlenderMCP](https://github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender): Connects Blender to Claude AI and other MCP clients through the Model Context Protocol for prompt-assisted 3D modeling, scene creation, and manipulation. `[MIT]`
- [FastMCP for Blender](https://github.com/sandraschi/blender-mcp): Headless Blender automation server via FastMCP with 41 tools covering mesh, VSE, Grease Pencil, and VRM workflows. `[MIT]`
- [blender-kiln](https://github.com/elithril/blender-kiln): A Claude Code plugin that drives Blender through an MCP server to build, texture, optimize, and export game-ready assets from a text brief or a photo. `[MIT]`
- [Blender Agent Skills](https://github.com/EL4CTEO/blender-skills): Professional Blender workflows packaged as Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. `[MIT]`
- [DESIGN:OS 3D Blender](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender): Agent toolkit that lets AI coding agents build models in Blender with a `bpy` knowledge base, an execution contract, and a 3D-print production gate. `[open-source]`
- [AnyScene](https://github.com/apekshik/anyscene): Multi-agent pipeline that generates complete, photorealistic 3D Blender scenes from a text prompt, handling prop generation, room layout, atmosphere, and cinematic rendering. [[video demo]](https://x.com/apekshik/status/2116638903923073290) `[MIT]`
- [AI Art Engine](https://github.com/Justin-sky/ai-art-engine): Node-based game asset studio with a built-in Blender TCP bridge and 24 dedicated MCP tools for 3D mesh modeling, armature rigging, PBR baking, and glTF/FBX export to Unity, Godot, and Cocos. `[GPL]`
- [Construct for Blender](https://github.com/rtmandreyev/construct/tree/main/hosts/blender): Imports constructs written by AI agents (scene JSON, worlds or glTF) with their named parts, joints and assembly, with sidebar controls for build, opening, hologram to solid and finish, and keyframed reveals. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/rtmandreyev/construct))
- [Mixar](https://www.mixar.app/): AI-powered 3D suite built as a custom fork of Blender with an integrated chat agent (Mixie), layer-based texture painting, and generative 3D tools. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Mixar-AI/mixar-app))
- [Blender Agent Studio](https://github.com/ifBars/blender-agent-studio): Open-source Blender AI plugin and skill suite for Claude Code and Codex that produces editable `.blend` scenes, Python scripts, and visually reviewed renders locally. `[MIT]`
- [blender-mcp-bridge](https://github.com/seehiong/blender-mcp-bridge): MCP bridge with 93 tools for Blender modeling, sculpting, architecture/MEP, materials, and 3D-print prep, plus a visual record/replay session editor. `[MIT]`
- [bpy-dev/blender-mcp](https://github.com/bpy-dev/blender-mcp): Enhanced Blender MCP distribution offering standalone `bpy` execution, runtime API documentation lookup, and benchmark tooling. `[GPL]`
- [Blender Assembly Skill](https://github.com/ProfRino/Blender-MCP-Assembly-Skill): Geometry-planning agent skill for Blender MCP workflows that verifies connections, primitive scaling, rotations, and object overlaps to prevent common AI modeling errors. `[open-source]`
- [dcc-mcp-blender](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-blender): Typed Blender MCP add-on in the multi-DCC `dcc-mcp` ecosystem enabling AI agents to model, edit UVs, rig, build materials, and render scenes. `[MIT]`

### Generative 3D & ComfyUI

- [ComfyUI-BlenderAI-node](https://github.com/AIGODLIKE/ComfyUI-BlenderAI-node): Popular node-based ComfyUI integration inside Blender for AI model generation, texture enhancement, and AI-assisted rendering. `[GPL]`
- [BlenderAIStudio](https://github.com/AIGODLIKE/BlenderAIStudio): Next-generation AI workflow studio add-on for Blender built on the Addon UI-Forge framework by AIGODLIKE. `[GPL]`
- [ComfyUI-Blender](https://github.com/alexisrolland/ComfyUI-Blender): Blender add-on to run ComfyUI workflows directly inside Blender for AI texture, image, and 3D asset generation. `[open-source]`
- [Scenario for Blender](https://github.com/scenario-labs/blender-plugin): AI image, video, 3D, and PBR material generation in the viewport, plus a local MCP server for agents. `[GPL]`
- [UniRig](https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/UniRig): Universal AI automatic skeletal rigging and skinning framework (SIGGRAPH 2025) by Tsinghua & VAST with Blender workflow and VRM add-on integration. `[MIT]`
- [Tripo 3D for Blender](https://github.com/Tripo-Developer/tripo-3d-for-blender): Official open-source Blender extension for Tripo AI enabling Text/Image-to-3D generation and textured, rig-ready asset imports inside the viewport sidebar. `[MIT]`
- [Meshy for Blender](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/webapp/plugins/blender/introduction): Official local bridge plugin from Meshy AI for sending static or rigged/animated 3D assets directly into Blender alongside mesh cleanup and 3D-print tools. `[paid]`
- [trellisblender](https://github.com/FishWoWater/trellis_blender): Blender sidebar integration for Microsoft's [TRELLIS](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS) and [TRELLIS.2](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS.2) models supporting local Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D generation. `[open-source]` ([TRELLIS](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS), [TRELLIS.2](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS.2))
- [Hunyuan3D-2](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2): High-resolution open-source 3D asset creation system (Text/Image-to-3D geometry and PBR textures) with an official Blender add-on. `[open-source]`
- [ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1](https://github.com/visualbruno/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3d-2-1): ComfyUI wrapper for [Hunyuan3D-2.1](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2.1) bringing fully open-source PBR texture synthesis workflows to Blender + ComfyUI pipelines. `[open-source]` ([Hunyuan3D-2.1](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2.1))
- [ComfyUI-LATO2](https://github.com/sakalond/ComfyUI-LATO2): ComfyUI low-poly remeshing node designed to convert dense AI-generated meshes (`TRELLIS.2`, `Hunyuan3D`, 3D scans) into clean quad/low-poly topology. `[GPL]`
- [AssetFurnace](https://github.com/Bingeljell/image-to-3dlab): Complete open-source image-to-3D pipeline generating textured, rigged, and animated game characters locally via TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D. `[open-source]`
- [Dream Textures](https://github.com/carson-katri/dream-textures): Stable Diffusion built-in to the Blender shader editor, image editor, and compositor. `[GPL]`
- [AI Render](https://github.com/benrugg/AI-Render): Stable Diffusion in Blender. This add-on renders an AI generated image based on a text prompt and your scene. `[open-source]`
- [Pallaidium](https://github.com/tin2tin/Pallaidium): Generative AI movie studio integrated into the Blender Video Sequence Editor (VSE) for text, image, audio, and video generation. `[GPL]`

### Synthetic Data & Benchmarks

#### Synthetic Data & Vision AI

- [BlenderProc](https://github.com/DLR-RM/BlenderProc): A procedural Blender pipeline for photorealistic training image generation. `[GPL]`
- [BlenderSynth](https://github.com/OllieBoyne/BlenderSynth): Blender scripting for generating synthetic datasets at scale. `[open-source]`
- [Kubric](https://github.com/google-research/kubric): Data generation pipeline by Google Research for creating semi-realistic synthetic multi-object videos with rich ground-truth annotations using Blender and PyBullet. `[open-source]`
- [SceneWeaver](https://github.com/Scene-Weaver/SceneWeaver): NeurIPS 2025 extensible, self-reflective agent framework for all-in-one 3D scene synthesis built on Infinigen and Blender. `[open-source]`

#### Benchmarks & Prompts

- [BlenderWorld](https://github.com/QwenLM/BlenderWorld): Visual agent benchmark by QwenLM containing 223 tasks and 2,651 criteria evaluating editable 3D Blender scene creation from real-world references. `[MIT]`
- [BlenderGym](https://github.com/richard-guyunqi/BlenderGym-Open): CVPR VLM benchmark evaluating code-based 3D graphics editing in Blender across 245 scenes (procedural geometry, lighting, materials, blend shapes, and placement). `[open-source]`
- [BlenderAlchemy](https://github.com/ianhuang0630/BlenderAlchemyOfficial): ECCV 2024 Stanford research framework treating VLM-driven 3D Blender scene edits as iterative visual programs. `[open-source]`
- [Blender AI Arena](https://blenderai.org/): Community-driven benchmark, prompt sets, and blind Elo/Glicko-2 leaderboard comparing 3D generative AI models and agents in Blender.
- [Awesome Astra Prompts](https://github.com/TripoGrowthLab/awesome-astra-prompts): Curated 3D prompt collection and examples for generative AI models, games, and Blender scenes. `[open-source]`

## Resources

### 3D Models

#### Free & CC0 3D Asset Libraries

- [Poly Haven/Models](https://polyhaven.com/models): Resource of free high quality 3D assets for everyone. All models here are CC0. `[ZERO]`
- [TheBaseMesh.com](https://www.thebasemesh.com/model-library): A public library of over 600+ base meshes. All assets are real world scale and come unwrapped. `[ZERO]`
- [Kenney 3D Assets](https://kenney.nl/assets/category:3D): Hundreds of clean CC0 low-poly and game-ready 3D models ready for Blender and game engines. `[ZERO]`
- [Blender Boom](https://www.blenderboom.com/product-category/free/): 3D model repository. Free models ready to use. `[ZERO]`
- [Chocofur/Free](https://store.chocofur.com/): Premium quality 3D models & scenes. `[ZERO]`
- [Greeble Town](https://greebletown.com/): Free premium quality sci-fi greebles hardsurface kitbash 3D assets.
- [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza/): Free CC0 and Creative Commons low-poly 3D models ready for Blender, games, and rapid prototyping.
- [Rigmodels](https://rigmodels.com/): Free rigged, animated and low poly models
- [NASA-3D-Resources](https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/): Growing collection of free 3D models, spacecraft, terrain scans, and textures from NASA. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources))

#### Marketplaces & Mixed-License Hubs

- [Fab (Quixel Megascans)](https://www.fab.com/): Epic Games' unified 3D marketplace featuring the entire permanently free Quixel Megascans library alongside free and commercial assets for Blender and other DCC tools.
- [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/search?features=downloadable&sort_by=-pertinence&type=models): Free downloadable models from Sketchfab.
- [CGTrader](https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models): Free 3D models from CGTrader.
- [TurboSquid/free](https://www.turbosquid.com/Search/3D-Models/free): Free models from Turbosquid.
- [Free3D](https://free3d.com/): Community platform to browse and download free 3D assets in `.blend`, `.obj`, and `.fbx` formats. `[CC]`
- [3D Warehouse](https://3dwarehouse.sketchup.com/search/): Download sketchup models.
- [RenderHub/free](https://www.renderhub.com/free-3d-models): Daz Content, 3D models, textures and materials.
- [FlyingArchitecture](https://flyingarchitecture.com/): Is both an architectural visualizations studio as well as an online store dedicated to 3D models, scenes, materials and tutorials.
- [KitBash3d](https://kitbash3d.com/): Makes premium 3D assets for VFX, concept art and design. Their 3D model kits have immediately been adopted by the industry's top artists, studios. _Get [Mini Kit: Neo City](https://kitbash3d.com/collections/kits/products/mini-kit-neo-city)_ for free. `[paid]` ([Mini Kit: Neo City](https://kitbash3d.com/collections/kits/products/mini-kit-neo-city))

[[mixed license]](https://www.myminifactory.com/scantheworld/faq/#licensing)

### Mocap/Animation

#### Free Mocap & Animation Libraries

- [Mixamo](https://www.mixamo.com/): Free auto-rigging and thousands of downloadable character animations for games, film, and Blender workflows.
- [Quaternius Universal Animation Library](https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html): Free game-ready humanoid animation pack distributed in clean `FBX` and `GLB` formats. `[ZERO]`
- [CMU Motion Capture Database](https://sites.google.com/a/cgspeed.com/cgspeed/motion-capture): 2,500+ free human motion capture animations in `.bvh` format from Carnegie Mellon University.
- [ACCAD Open Motion Project](https://accad.osu.edu/research/motion-lab/mocap-system-and-data): Open motion capture archive (`.bvh` / `.c3d`) from Ohio State University covering locomotion, martial arts, and everyday motions.
- [Bandai Namco Research Motiondataset](https://github.com/BandaiNamcoResearchInc/Bandai-Namco-Research-Motiondataset): Large stylized human motion-capture dataset released by Bandai Namco Research for personal and academic use. `[open-source]`
- [AMASS](https://amass.is.tue.mpg.de/): Large-scale archive unifying 15+ optical motion capture datasets (including CMU) into a standard SMPL human skeleton representation.
- [Rokoko Studio](https://www.rokoko.com/products/studio/download): Includes 150+ free animations in Rokoko's Motion Library alongside Blender retargeting workflows.
- [ActorCore](https://actorcore.reallusion.com/free): Motion-capture animation library from Reallusion featuring free starter packs and commercial assets.
- **turbosquid/motion-capture / Sketchfab/animated**: [turbosquid/motion-capture](https://www.turbosquid.com/Search/Motion-Capture/free/), [Sketchfab/animated](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models?features=downloadable+animated&sort_by=-likeCount)

#### AI Video-to-Mocap & Markerless Capture

- [FreeMocap](https://freemocap.org/): Free, open-source markerless 3D motion capture studio using standard cameras/webcams with built-in Blender scene and rig export. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/freemocap/freemocap))
- [GVHMR](https://github.com/zju3dv/GVHMR): Gravity-aware AI 3D human motion recovery from single-camera monocular video for animation and SMPL/Blender pipelines. `[open-source]`
- [DeepMotion](https://www.deepmotion.com/): Cloud AI video-to-mocap tool capturing full-body, hand, and facial motion with `FBX`, `BVH`, and `GLB` exports for Blender. `[paid]`
- [Move.ai](https://www.move.ai/): Markerless single- and multi-camera AI motion capture with production `FBX` export. `[paid]`
- [Plask](https://plask.ai/en-US): Browser-based AI video-to-mocap and keyframe cleanup platform exporting `FBX` and `BVH` animations. `[paid]`

### Textures

#### CC0 & Open PBR Texture Libraries

- [Poly Haven/Textures](https://polyhaven.com/textures): Poly Haven/Textures is a website where you can find high quality scanned textures for free. `[ZERO]`
- [ambientCG](https://ambientcg.com/): Get hundreds of PBR materials and textures for free under the Public Domain license. `[ZERO]`
- [cgbookcase](https://www.cgbookcase.com/textures): Discover a library of high-quality PBR textures. Free for every purpose, forever. Some Blender tutorials here and there. `[ZERO]`
- [3DAssets.one](https://3dassets.one/): Search-engine allowing you to explore the largest free CC0 PBR texture, model, and HDRI sites all at once.
- [3DTextures.me](https://3dtextures.me/): Free seamless PBR textures. `[ZERO]`
- [CC0 Materials](https://cc0materials.com/): Free PBR materials up to 4K with OpenGL and DirectX normal maps and a 3D preview. `[ZERO]`
- [FreePBR.com](https://freepbr.com/): Free PBR materials and texture files.
- [twirl](https://twirl.tools/dashboard): Free library of high quality PBR materials. Unlimited downloads with no signup.
- [ShareTextures](https://www.sharetextures.com/): Free High Quality Material Archive for everybody. `[ZERO]`
- [TextureCan](https://www.texturecan.com/): Free CC0 PBR textures and material maps for 3D rendering and game development. `[ZERO]`
- [Texture.Ninja](https://texture.ninja/): Public domain photographic textures, reference images, cutouts. `[ZERO]`
- [3DTexel](https://3dtexel.com/pbr-material/): 1,000+ handmade seamless PBR materials in 4K (some up to 8K), including stylized/hand-painted ones. Free account required. `[ZERO]`
- [Texture Box](https://texturebox.com/): We are making free textures for 3D Artists from all over the world. Also, we offer custome texture services.
- [MatCaps](https://github.com/nidorx/matcaps): Huge library of matcap PNG textures organized by color. `[open-source]`

#### Freemium, Commercial & Specialized Libraries

- [Textures.com](https://www.textures.com/): Website that offers digital pictures of all sorts of materials. Sign up for free and download 15 free images every day! `[paid]`
- [LotPixel](https://www.lotpixel.com/texture-library?credit=free): Free scan-based textures of interior and exterior materials at up to 8K resolution. For commercial use.
- [MaterialX Library](https://matlib.gpuopen.com/main/materials/all): AMD launched a free MaterialX-based Material Library. It allows users to download the materials and encourages them to upload their own.
- [IES Library](https://ieslibrary.com/browse): Download free IES lighting files. IES files describe how light from a lamp is distributed in a room.
- [Adobe Substance 3D Assets](https://substance3d.adobe.com/assets/): Official PBR material library from Adobe Substance 3D, alongside free [Community Assets](https://substance3d.adobe.com/community-assets/). `[paid]` ([Community Assets](https://substance3d.adobe.com/community-assets/))
- [ScansLibrary](https://www.scanslibrary.com/library?credit=0): Digital marketplace with thousands of Real-World scans. `[paid]`
- [Poliigon/freebies](https://www.poliigon.com/search?credit=0): A library of materials, and HDR's for artists including free textures that want photorealism. `[paid]`
- [Texturing.xyz](https://texturing.xyz/): Our textures are used in the biggest and industry-leading VFX companies, and help them achieving their goals faster. `[paid]`
- [Solar Textures](https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/): Real planetary maps in equirectangular projection based on NASA elevation and imagery data. `[BY]`
- **Planetary & Space Maps**: [CGI Moon Kit](https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/), [Moon 64k](https://gumroad.com/l/MOON_46K), [Earth 42k](https://gumroad.com/l/uHyhPT), [Planets Pack](https://gumroad.com/l/qMZOE)

#### Other Collections

- **Other Collections**: [gumroad/juliosillet](https://gumroad.com/juliosillet), [Pixar/CommunityResources](https://renderman.pixar.com/community_resources), [Sketchup Texture Club](https://www.sketchuptextureclub.com/textures), [treesDesigner PBR Leaf Textures](https://www.treesdesigner.com/materials-library/)

### Blender Scenes/Files

- [Blender Open Data](https://opendata.blender.org/): Official Cycles and hardware performance benchmark `.blend` scenes and open test database.
- [NVIDIA ORCA](https://developer.nvidia.com/orca): Open Research Content Archive hosting large-scale PBR and ray-tracing benchmark scenes such as Amazon Lumberyard Bistro.
- [Disney Moana Island Scene](https://www.disneyanimation.com/resources/moana-island-scene/): Production OpenUSD Motunui Island dataset released by Walt Disney Animation Studios for large-scale instancing and lighting tests.

([Rain v2](https://studio.blender.org/characters/rain/v2/), [Snow v2](https://studio.blender.org/characters/snow/v2/))

### HDRIs

#### CC0 & Production HDRI Libraries

- [Poly Haven/HDRIs](https://polyhaven.com/hdris): Hundreds of free CC0 high-resolution HDRI skies, indoor studios, and environments up to 16K+. `[ZERO]`
- [OpenHDRI](https://openhdri.org/): Ad-free, account-free library of ultra-high-resolution CC0 HDRI environment maps up to 29K. `[ZERO]`
- [ambientCG/HDRIs](https://ambientcg.com/list?type=hdri): Free CC0 public-domain HDRI environment maps in multiple resolutions up to 16K+. `[ZERO]`
- [Pixar/HDRI](https://renderman.pixar.com/category/111-hdri): Free production-ready HDRI environments from Pixar RenderMan resources.
- [HDRMaps/Freebies](https://hdrmaps.com/freebies/): Free high-dynamic-range panoramas and photogrammetry backgrounds.

- **Other Free HDRI Libraries**: [Openfootage](https://www.openfootage.net/hdri-panorama/), [HDRI-Skies](https://hdri-skies.com/free-hdris/), [HDRI-Hub](https://www.hdri-hub.com/shop/free-samples/free-hdri-downloads), [Viz-People](https://www.viz-people.com/portfolio/free-hdri-maps/), [Noah Witchell](https://www.noahwitchell.com/freebies)

### Art/Reference

#### Open-Access Museums & Art Archives

- [Dezoomify](https://dezoomify.ophir.dev/): Download zoomable images from [Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/), [The National Gallery](https://www.nationalgallery.org.uk/), [Gallica](https://gallica.bnf.fr/), [Van Gogh Museum](https://www.vangoghmuseum.nl/en/collection) and [more](https://github.com/lovasoa/dezoomify#supported-zoomable-image-formats). `[open-source]` ([Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/), [The National Gallery](https://www.nationalgallery.org.uk/), [Gallica](https://gallica.bnf.fr/), [Van Gogh Museum](https://www.vangoghmuseum.nl/en/collection), [more](https://github.com/lovasoa/dezoomify#supported-zoomable-image-formats), [Repository](https://github.com/lovasoa/dezoomify))
- [The Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search#!?searchField=All&showOnly=openAccess&sortBy=Relevance&offset=0&pageSize=0): Browse more than 406,000 hi-res images of public-domain works in The Met collection that can be downloaded, shared, and remixed without restriction.
- [Smithsonian Open Access](https://www.si.edu/openaccess): Download, share, and reuse millions of the Smithsonian’s images right now, without asking. `[ZERO]`
- [Rijksmuseum](https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/collection/search): One of the largest museums in Europe dedicated to arts and history, with hundreds of thousands of works available for free online viewing or download.
- [Wikimedia Commons/Art](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Art): A collection of freely usable media files to which anyone can contribute. `[CC]`

#### Anatomy, Nature, Historical & Concept References

- [Anatomy 360, Free Reference](https://anatomy360.info/anatomy-scan-reference-dump/): 3D scanned human reference images.
- [Wildlife Reference Photos](https://wildlifereferencephotos.com/gallery.php?mode=newest-media&page=1): Wildlife reference photos for artists.
- [Biodiversity Heritage Library](https://www.flickr.com/photos/biodivlibrary/): 300,000+ Botanical and Animal Illustrations available for free download. `[ZERO]`
- [Natural History Museum, Data Portal](https://data.nhm.ac.uk/): Explore and download the Museum’s research and collections data. Collection information, images, sounds, videos, research results, 3D scans.
- [Mindat, Mineral Database](https://www.mindat.org/): Is the world's largest open database of minerals, rocks, meteorites and the localities they come from.
- [The Empire University, Weapons Library](https://dinustyempire.notion.site/6-1-Weapons-library-0ab1d28137e749f0abfca738d93a9222): Free reference resource for many types of weapons.
- [Old Maps Online](https://www.oldmapsonline.org/): Discovering the Cartography of the Past. Welcome to Old Maps Online, the easy-to-use gateway to historical maps in libraries around the world.
- [Flickr, Creative Commons](https://www.flickr.com/creativecommons/): Many Flickr users have chosen to offer their work under a Creative Commons license.
- **NASA Space Imagery**: [James Webb Images](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/webb/multimedia/images/), [Hubble Image Gallery](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/hubble/multimedia/hubble-images/), [Astronomy Picture of the Day](https://science.nasa.gov/apod/archive/)

### Sound/Music

#### Sound Effects (SFX)

- [Freesound.org](https://freesound.org/browse/): Collaborative database of creative-commons licensed sound for musicians and sound lovers. `[CC]`
- [GameAudioGDC](https://sonniss.com/gameaudiogdc/): Each year we give away thousands of dollars worth of sound effects for free in celebration of the Game Developers Conference. This is our archive. Everything is royalty-free and commercially usable.
- [Kenney Audio](https://kenney.nl/assets/category:Audio): Clean CC0 game, UI, and interface sound effect packs ready for games and animations. `[ZERO]`
- [Pixabay Sound Effects](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/): Royalty-free sound effects and ambient tracks ready for commercial projects without attribution.
- [SFXMint](https://sfxmint.com/): CC0 library of 10,300+ sound effects for games and videos; sounds are AI-generated or synthesized. `[ZERO]`
- [99Sounds.org](https://99sounds.org/free-sound-effects/): Website offering free downloads of royalty-free content generated by its own users.
- [OpenGameArt.org/Sound](https://opengameart.org/art-search-advanced?keys=&title=&field_art_tags_tid_op=or&field_art_tags_tid=&name=&field_art_type_tid%5B%5D=13&sort_by=created&sort_order=DESC&items_per_page=24&Collection=): Sound Effects from OpenGameArt.
- [BBC Sound Effects](https://sound-effects.bbcrewind.co.uk/): Archive of 33,000+ real-world sound effects (free for personal, educational, and research use under the RemArc license).

#### Royalty-Free & Creative Commons Music

- [Free Music Archive](https://freemusicarchive.org/home): The iconic resource for free music, podcast safe and royalty free music for video.
- [Incompetech](https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html): Classic royalty-free music library by Kevin MacLeod widely used in short films, animations, and YouTube videos. `[BY]`
- [Pixabay/music](https://pixabay.com/music/): Royalty free music from Pixabay.
- [Mixkit](https://mixkit.co/free-stock-music/): Download free stock music, sound effects, and video footage without attribution.
- [MusOpen.org](https://musopen.org/music/): Online classical music library of copyright free, public domain music. `[CC]`
- [ccMixter.org](https://dig.ccmixter.org/): Community remix site operated by ArtisTech Media, created by Creative Commons. `[CC]`

#### AI Foley, Video-to-Audio & Synth Generators

- [MMAudio](https://github.com/hkchengrex/MMAudio): Open-source CVPR 2025 multimodal Video-to-Audio synthesis model that generates frame-synchronized foley and ambient sound from silent 3D renders and videos. `[MIT]`
- [HunyuanVideo-Foley](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanVideo-Foley): Open-source Text-and-Video-to-Audio framework synthesizing 48kHz high-fidelity cinematic foley synchronized with video motion. `[open-source]`
- [AudioCraft](https://github.com/facebookresearch/audiocraft): Open-source deep learning audio suite by Meta including MusicGen and AudioGen for text-to-music and text-to-SFX generation. `[MIT]`
- [jsfxr](https://sfxr.me/): Open-source browser-based procedural sound effect synthesizer ideal for retro, UI, and game SFX. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/chr15m/jsfxr))
- [ElevenLabs Sound Effects](https://elevenlabs.io/sound-effects): AI text-to-sound-effects generator for custom foley, ambiences, and impacts (free starter tier). `[paid]`

## Standalone

### 3D Tools

#### Mesh Processing, Retopology & Voxels

- [MeshLab](https://www.meshlab.net/): Open source system for processing and editing 3D triangular meshes. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/meshlab))
- [AutoRemesher](https://github.com/huxingyi/autoremesher): Open-source auto-retopology tool intended to convert source meshes into clean, animation-friendly all-quad geometry. `[open-source]`
- [Instant Meshes](https://github.com/wjakob/instant-meshes): Interactive field-aligned mesh generator. `[open-source]`
- [Magica Voxel](https://ephtracy.github.io/index.html?page=mv_main): A free lightweight 8-bit voxel art editor and GPU based interactive path tracing renderer.
- [Goxel](https://github.com/guillaumechereau/goxel): Create voxel graphics. Export to obj, pyl, png, magica voxel, qubicle. `[open-source]`
- [aerialod](https://ephtracy.github.io/index.html?page=aerialod): A free interactive path tracing renderer for height maps.

#### Characters, Sculpting, Rigging & Animation

- [VRoid Studio](https://vroid.com/en/studio): A 3D character maker that specializes in Japanese anime-like expressions.
- [AccuRIG](https://actorcore.reallusion.com/auto-rig): Free application designed for fast and easy character rigging.
- [Cascadeur](https://cascadeur.com/): Standalone software for creating keyframe animation of 3D characters, humanoid or otherwise. _Free for early adopters._
- [Nomad Sculpt](https://nomadsculpt.com/): Popular portable sculpting and vertex-painting application for iPad, Android, and desktop with clean exports to Blender. `[paid]`

#### Modeling, Architecture, Volumetrics & Scene Tools

- [Blockbench](https://www.blockbench.net/): Open-source low-poly and pixel-textured 3D model editor with native glTF/OBJ workflows for Blender and game engines. `[GPL]` ([Repository](https://github.com/JannisX11/blockbench))
- [Plasticity](https://www.plasticity.xyz/): NURBS modeling CAD tool built for concept artists and hard-surface workflows alongside Blender. `[paid · open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nkallen/plasticity))
- [FreeCAD](https://www.freecad.org/): Open-source parametric 3D CAD modeler suitable for precision mechanical parts and 3D printing exported to Blender. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD))
- [Dust3D](https://dust3d.org/): Cross-platform open-source modeling software. It helps you create a 3D watertight model in seconds.
- [Sweet Home 3D](https://www.sweethome3d.com/): Free interior design application that helps you draw the plan of your house, arrange furniture on it and visit the results in 3D. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://sourceforge.net/projects/sweethome3d/files/))
- [Spline](https://spline.design/): Easily create and publish 3D web experiences. Build and iterate fast with production-ready results.
- [TreeIt](https://www.evolved-software.com/treeit/treeit): Easy to use real time 3D tree generator for the simple creation.
- [EmberGen](https://jangafx.com/software/embergen/): Real-time volumetric fluid simulation tool that can instantly simulate, render, and export flipbooks, image sequences, and VDB volumes. `[paid]`
- [HDR Light Studio](https://www.lightmap.co.uk/): Lets you easily create and edit HDR lighting with your existing 3D software. `[paid]`
- [CNDL](https://cndl.io/): An IES lighting creation toolset. Improve your renders with custom IES lighting.
- [Connecter](https://connecterapp.com/): Free and visual creative assets management for 3d, AEC and design professionals.
- [Phototiler](https://halfmaps.itch.io/phototiler): Lightweight photorealistic map renderer that allows quick rendering of 3D maps for creative cartography.

### Various Tools

#### Reference Boards & Media Review

- [PureRef](https://www.pureref.com/): Simple way to view and organize your reference images.
- [Allusion](https://allusion-app.github.io/): Organizer for your entire collection of references, inspiration and any other kinds of images. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/allusion-app/Allusion))
- [DJV](https://grizzlypeak3d.github.io/DJV/): Professional image sequence, media review software for VFX, animation, and film production. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/grizzlypeak3d/DJV))
- [Exr-IO](https://www.exr-io.com/): Robust and exact solution for dealing with multi-layer EXR pictures. It supports Cryptomatte.
- [GameTextureViewer](https://jangafx.com/software/gametextureviewer/): Fast, reliable, and simple tool for artists to preview textures and sprite sheet animations on the fly.

#### Compositing, Shaders & Particles

- [Natron](https://natrongithub.github.io/): Open Source Compositing Software For VFX and Motion Graphics. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/NatronGitHub/Natron))
- [SHADERed](https://github.com/dfranx/SHADERed): Lightweight tool for creating and testing HLSL and GLSL shaders. `[open-source]`
- [CineShader](https://cineshader.com/editor): CineShader is a real-time 3D shader visualiser. It leverages the _Shadertoy_ API to bring thousands of existing shader artworks into a cinematic 3D environment.
- [Light Tracer Render](https://lighttracer.org/): Provides you with everything you need to create photorealistic renderings interactively, in both desktop Web browsers and Windows application.
- [Effekseer](https://effekseer.github.io/en/): Open source particle effect creating tool.
- [Particle Illusion](https://borisfx.com/products/particle-illusion/): Free GPU-accelerated 2D particle generator.
- [F3D](https://f3d.app): Fast and minimalist open source cross-platform 3D viewer. Support many fileformats and rendering style. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d))
- [Processing](https://processing.org/): Flexible software sketchbook and a language for learning how to code within the context of the visual arts. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/processing/processing))

#### Blender Tools & Custom Builds

- [Goo Engine](https://github.com/dillongoostudios/goo-engine): Custom open-source build of Blender by DillonGoo Studios tailored for 3D anime and Non-Photorealistic Rendering (NPR). `[GPL]`
- [Bforartists](https://www.bforartists.de/): Open-source Blender fork focused on streamlined UI ergonomics, menus, and discoverable workflows. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/Bforartists/Bforartists))
- [BlenderUpdater](https://github.com/overmindstudios/BlenderUpdater): Download and install nightly builds with one click. `[open-source]`
- [BlenderUpdaterCLI](https://github.com/overmindstudios/BlenderUpdaterCLI): Command line version of BlenderUpdater. `[open-source]`
- [Blender Launcher V2](https://github.com/Victor-IX/Blender-Launcher-V2): Standalone client for managing official builds of Blender. `[open-source]`
- [Blender Manager](https://github.com/verlorengest/BlenderManager): Auto-Update, Project Management and Time Tracking, Addon Control, Version Handling, Render Management, and More. `[open-source]`
- [Sheep it Render Farm](https://www.sheepit-renderfarm.com/): Free distributed render farm for Blender.

### Photogrammetry

- [Meshroom](https://alicevision.org/#meshroom): Free, open-source 3D Photogrammetry Software. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/alicevision/meshroom))
- [COLMAP](https://colmap.github.io/): Reconstruct 3D models from ordered or unordered image collections automatically. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/colmap/colmap))
- [3DF Zephyr Free](https://www.3dflow.net/3df-zephyr-free/): Is free version of 3DF Zephyr photogrammetry software for personal use. It comes with some limitations.
- [MicMac](https://github.com/micmacIGN/micmac): Free open-source photogrammetric suite that can be used in a variety of 3D reconstruction scenarios. `[open-source]`
- [RealityScan](https://www.realityscan.com/): Unified desktop and mobile photogrammetry suite by Epic Games (formerly RealityCapture), free under indie/small-revenue thresholds.
- [Agisoft Metashape](https://www.agisoft.com/): Stand-alone software product that performs photogrammetric processing of digital images and generates 3D spatial data. `[paid]`
- [Postshot](https://www.jawset.com/): Standalone desktop application for training and editing 3D Gaussian Splatting (`.ply`) and radiance field scenes ready for Blender.
- [Nerfstudio](https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/nerfstudio): Open-source studio for training, editing, and exporting NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. `[open-source]`
- [SuperSplat](https://superspl.at/editor): Free browser-based 3D Gaussian Splat editor for inspecting, cropping, cleaning, and exporting splat scenes. `[MIT]` ([Repository](https://github.com/playcanvas/supersplat))
- [Brush](https://github.com/ArthurBrussee/brush): Cross-platform 3D reconstruction and Gaussian Splatting training engine supporting real-time rendering. `[open-source]`
- [gsplat](https://docs.gsplat.studio/main/): Open-source CUDA-accelerated rasterization library for training and rendering 3D Gaussian Splats. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/gsplat))

### Texture/Material

- [ArmorPaint](https://armorpaint.org/): Open-Source 3D PBR Texture Painting Software. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/armory3d/armorpaint))
- [NVIDIA Texture Tools Exporter](https://developer.nvidia.com/texture-tools-exporter): Allows users to create highly compressed texture files (that stay small both on disk and in memory) directly from image sources using NVIDIA’s CUDA-accelerated Texture Tools compressor technology.
- [Materialize](https://boundingboxsoftware.com/materialize/): Stand alone tool for creating materials from images. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/BoundingBoxSoftware/Materialize))
- [Material Maker](https://rodzilla.itch.io/material-maker): Simple procedural materials generation tool. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/RodZill4/material-maker))
- [TextureLab](https://njbrown.itch.io/texturelab): Tool designed to make procedural texture generation.
- [Agisoft De-Lighter](https://agisoft.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/31000158376-agisoft-texture-de-lighter-general-workflow): Free stand-alone tool designed to remove shadows from model textures. [[download]](https://www.agisoft.com/downloads/installer/)
- [Agama Materials](https://agama.itch.io/agama-materials): Is software for creating PBR materials and painting 3d models. You can create materials and use them for painting models, or you can use pre-made textures.
- [Architextures - Create](https://architextures.org/create): Web app allows you to create seamless textures, bump maps and CAD hatches. Select any of the parameters to get started.
- [Normal Map Bench](https://normalmapbench.com/): Free browser-based normal map generator from images with live strength, smoothing, edge and lighting controls; OpenGL/DirectX export.

### Terrain & Height Maps

#### Terrain Generators

- [TerreSculptor](https://www.demenzunmedia.com/home/terresculptor/): Terrain creation and editing software. It is freeware.
- [World Machine](https://www.world-machine.com/): Command powerful tools like erosion and advanced colormaps to create terrain heightmaps, meshes, and textures for your game or 3D scene. You can use the Basic Edition for free.
- [Terragen](https://planetside.co.uk/free-downloads/): Ray-tracing supported terrain generator. There is free version with some limitations.
- [World Creator](https://www.bitethebytes.com/products/world-creator): Real-time terrain generator and landscape generator. `[paid]`
- [Gaea](https://quadspinner.com/): Sophisticated and modern terrain design software for apex results in moments. There is Community Free edition with some limitations.
- [Instant Terra](https://www.wysilab.com/): Real-time terrain generation tool. Create your terrain, world, and landscape for your game, movie, or simulation.

#### Real-World Height Maps

- [Tangram Heightmapper](https://tangrams.github.io/heightmapper/): Interactive grayscale heightmap browser, which can generate heightmaps for use in 3D applications.
- [OpenTopography/datasets](https://portal.opentopography.org/datasets): Facilitates community access to high-resolution, Earth science-oriented, topography data, and related tools and resources. _Registration required_.
- [Copernicus DEM - ESA](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions/collections-description/COP-DEM): The Copernicus Digital Elevation Model is a Digital Surface Model (DSM) that represents the surface of the Earth including buildings, infrastructure and vegetation.

### Point Cloud/LiDAR Data

- [OpenTopography](https://portal.opentopography.org/dataCatalog?formats=0): Collaborative data repository for LiDAR users.
- [NOAA’s Data Access Viewer](https://coast.noaa.gov/dataviewer/#/lidar/search/): This online tool allows a user to search for and download lidar, imagery, and land cover data.
- [United States Interagency Elevation Inventory](https://coast.noaa.gov/inventory/): Collaborative effort of the USGS and NOAA with contributions from other federal agencies.
- [USGS/TNM](https://apps.nationalmap.gov/downloader/): U.S. Geological The National Map. You can also use the [Earth Explorer (USGS)](https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/). [[info]](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-lidar-data-and-where-can-i-download-it?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products) ([Earth Explorer (USGS)](https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/))
- [USGS/Entwine](https://usgs.entwine.io/): This website provides Potree and Plasio.js interfaces to the AWS USGS LiDAR Public Dataset. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/hobuinc/usgs-lidar))
- **Sketchfab/lidar / Sketchfab/point-cloud**: [Sketchfab/lidar](https://sketchfab.com/tags/lidar), [Sketchfab/point-cloud](https://sketchfab.com/tags/point-cloud)

### Generator

- [JSplacement](https://archive.org/details/jsplacement-1.3.0-allplatforms_202108): Cross-platform pseudo-random 8K displacement map generator.
- [Procedural City Generator](https://probabletrain.itch.io/city-generator): Create procedurally generated city maps in the style of American grid-based cities. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/ProbableTrain/MapGenerator))
- [Medieval Fantasy City Generator](https://watabou.itch.io/medieval-fantasy-city-generator): This application generates a random medieval city layout of a requested size. [City Viewer](https://watabou.itch.io/city-viewer) : 3d-visualizer for MFCD. See other generators from [watabou.itch.io](https://watabou.itch.io/). ([City Viewer](https://watabou.itch.io/city-viewer), [watabou.itch.io](https://watabou.itch.io/))
- [city-roads](https://anvaka.github.io/city-roads/): This website allows you to select a city and then draws every single road on a screen. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/anvaka/city-roads))

### Painting, Audio & Post-Production

- [DaVinci Resolve](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/davinciresolve): Industry-standard NLE, color grading (ACES/AgX), and Fusion node compositing companion for Blender EXR sequences (free & Studio editions).
- [Krita](https://krita.org/en/): Professional free and open source painting program. It is made by artists that want to see affordable art tools for everyone. `[open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/KDE/krita))
- [HEAVYPAINT](https://www.heavypaint.com/): Simple app designed for graphic painting. The UI is streamlined for fluid, happy painting with as little friction as possible.
- [Audacity](https://www.audacityteam.org/): Free, open source, cross-platform audio software.
- [AudioMass](https://audiomass.co/): Open-source web based audio and waveform editing tool.

### Fundamentals & CG

- [Pixar in a Box](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities/hass-storytelling/storytelling-pixar-in-a-box): Pixar and Khan Academy have collaborated to create a series of learning tutorials demonstrating how math, science, and the arts power Pixar's filmmaking process. `[course]`
- [Skilly Blender Fundamentals Curriculum](https://github.com/tryskilly/skilly/tree/main/skills/blender-fundamentals): Open-source markdown curriculum sourced from the official Blender Manual covering Object vs Edit mode, viewport navigation, Properties Editor, core modifiers, materials, lighting, and rendering. `[doc · open-source]`
- [Computer Graphics from scratch](https://gabrielgambetta.com/computer-graphics-from-scratch/00-introduction.html): Teaches how raytracing and rasterization work from first principles without relying on OpenGL or DirectX. `[doc · open-source]` ([Repository](https://github.com/ggambetta/computer-graphics-from-scratch))
- [tinyraytracer](https://github.com/ssloy/tinyraytracer/wiki): Understandable raytracing implementation in 256 lines of bare C++. `[open-source]`
- [tinyrenderer](https://github.com/ssloy/tinyrenderer/wiki): How OpenGL works under the hood via software rendering in 500 lines of C++. `[open-source]`

### Scripting & Extensions

#### Documentation

- [Creating Extensions (Blender 4.2+)](https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/advanced/extensions/getting_started.html): Official manual on packaging add-ons and themes using `blender_manifest.toml` for the Blender Extensions Platform ([CLI Arguments](https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/advanced/command_line/extension_arguments.html)). `[doc]` ([CLI Arguments](https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/advanced/command_line/extension_arguments.html))
